append.description: Add to the existing file instead of replacing it. For a `.csp`, content is data rows placed under the existing header (repeating the header line is fine — it is deduplicated); for other files, content is appended as-is.

content.description: Full file content (replaces the note if it exists, unless append=true). A `.csp` is validated on write: the reply echoes the parsed columns and row count, and a malformed table (empty header cell, ragged row) is rejected without writing

doc.description: Indexed document path from grep/read (#n stripped server-side)

file.description: Note filename with extension. `.csp` = a limit table (`|`-separated rows, first line is ALWAYS the column headers — exact parameter names); any other extension is a free-form note
